outcome: perceptions of advantages and disadvantages of different delivery modes
cohort: 111 pregnant women with a mean age of 31 years
finding: The majority (63.1%) of multiparous women preferred caesarean section, and this preference was associated with increased fear of childbirth and specific perceptions about the advantages and disadvantages of each delivery mode.
mod_finding: Most multiparous women preferred cesarean section as a mode of delivery (63.1%).
